title: Dentistry: Locum Tenens & Permanent Blogs
summary: Are you a traveling dentist or dental hygienist? Stay informed and read the latest news in travel dentistry on the AMN Healthcare blog.
body_markdown: Our recruiters take the time to learn your priorities: the procedures you want to perform, the practice environment that suits you, your preferred location, and your long-term career goals. From there, they match you with permanent jobs that align with your skills and your life, not just your credentials.
